story:
Title: THE INTERVIEW

Hook:
I walked into an executive interview with absolutely zero preparation.

Scene 1:
A broke, disheveled college student named Leo sits in an oversized leather chair across a sleek glass desk from Ms. Vance, a sharp senior corporate vice president. Ms. Vance peers over her designer glasses, clicks her pen, and asks:
"So, Leo... where do you see yourself in five years?"

Scene 2:
Leo leans back with completely unearned confidence, making unflinching deadpan eye contact. He replies:
"Honestly? In your position."
Ms. Vance arches an eyebrow, a faint cynical smirk breaking her poker face:
"Ambitious. And what exactly would you do if you got my position?"

Scene 3:
A pregnant awkward pause. Leo doesn't blink, deadpan delivery, completely flat and matter-of-fact:
"Hire someone to answer stupid questions."
Total deafening room silence. The fluorescent lights hum.

Scene 4:
Ms. Vance stares in dead silence, then slowly closes the heavy manila folder on her desk with an authoritative slap.
"You're hired."
Leo's stoic posture instantly collapses into sheer bewilderment:
"Wait... seriously?"

Scene 5:
Ms. Vance takes off her glasses, leans forward over the desk, dropping the corporate facade, and whispers:
"Yeah. We desperately need someone who can insult upper management without HR noticing."

Punchline:
Turns out... that was the qualification.

director_notes.visual_style: Sterile high-end corporate aesthetic using a desaturated slate-blue and charcoal palette punctuated by muted amber wood tones. Mid-to-high contrast with deep clean shadows, subtle highlight halation on glass surfaces, and a crisp 35mm digital sensor finish. Low visual saturation creates a cold, clinical environment that heightens the deadpan comedic weight.
director_notes.camera_style: Static tripod framing and ultra-slow linear push-ins only, keeping eye lines locked within the center 60% vertical safe zone for 9:16 aspect ratio. Shallow depth-of-field utilizing 50mm human perspective and 85mm portrait lenses to isolate character reactions with buttery background bokeh. Zero camera shake, fast whip pans, or chaotic tracking shots.
director_notes.lighting: Motivated 4200K overhead diffused fluorescent fixture soft light balanced by cool 5600K daylight side-lighting through massive executive suite windows. Faint volumetric office haze with clean, controlled shadow depth and realistic table-top reflections on sleek glass.
director_notes.editing: Calculated, precise pacing averaging 4-6 second holds per shot to emphasize awkward silences and facial beats. Direct hard cuts timed strictly to deadpan audio cues, completely devoid of cross-dissolves or flashy transition effects.
director_notes.music: 75 BPM, deadpan corporate satire mood, featuring muted pizzicato strings, faint rhythmic clock-ticking percussion, and low cello drone, sparse chamber texture with a sudden complete audio drop on the comedic pauses.
director_notes.style_lock: Cinematic corporate satire, sterile slate-blue and amber 4200K palette, motivated soft overhead fluorescent light with clean volumetric haze, crisp 35mm digital grain, photorealistic high-end office photography.
avoid: rapid camera whip pans or sudden zooms
morphing facial features or shifting clothing colors
extra fingers, extra limbs, or distorted anatomy
text overlays, subtitles, logos, or watermarks inside video frame
unwanted additional characters entering the frame
blown-out unnatural digital highlights and pixel noise
